meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Compared native article discovery, keyword passage selection, public file revision and excerpt hashes, and trace projections with the role guidance and wire fixtures.

auth.review_note: Compared the runtime article permission with the authentication and Google OAuth guidance. Native lookup uses the existing actor policy and grants no customer or owner privileges.

commerce.review_note: Reviewed the retrieval addition to the backend skill against the commerce guides. Article claims use source evidence; product, order and payment projections still use their named data services.

content.review_note: Compared BlogService publication and generated HTML with the article documentation. Both native agents now find published body matches and read bounded exact-slug passages.

foundation.review_note: Reviewed passage retrieval against the native PHP, private JSON and published Markdown boundaries. The tool result carries the passage; the private trace keeps its identity, digests and numeric section only.

google-tags.review_note: Reviewed unchanged public layout head rendering against the documented Google tag integration.

http-errors.review_note: Compared Blog setting and publication checks with the PHP failure boundary. A missing passage is a normal tool result and a failed settings read still surfaces as a source failure.

interface.review_note: Verified focus and visibility when reopening a scrolled Support enquiry at 375px, alongside the menu, footer and shared accessibility guidance.

mail.review_note: Reviewed the retrieval addition to the backend skill against the mail guide. Reading article passages requires no mail queue, recipient lookup or message send.

mcp-clients.review_note: Reviewed the revised Settings help alongside MCP client setup guidance. The change is confined to public Header menu guidance.

media.review_note: Compared active-chat restoration and attachment changes with the media operator instructions, and confirmed upload and in-memory draft attachment regressions pass.

operator-help.review_note: Cross-checked the published customer help guide with the new article lookup. Exact-slug reads use the public Blog gate and cannot select the authenticated operator guide.

public-mcp.review_note: Compared the shared knowledge service with the public MCP article schema. The MCP and browser clients still receive title and summary ranking and the same result fields.

remote-commerce.review_note: Reviewed the backend skill change against the remote checkout contracts. The published article lookup remains a read and does not use cart or payment capabilities.

sales-channels.review_note: Reviewed SettingsService module resolution and Merchant feed guidance. Dropping a retired header slot leaves the saved catalog eligibility inputs intact.

workflow.review_note: Reviewed the new backend skill guidance and Chat Completions loopback assertions against the source review workflow. The approved authored Markdown and versioned tool contract remain the sources of truth.
